name: lather_atlas
theme: a soap-foam micro-cosmos in a kitchen sink — an evening basin, a packed field of bubble domes, one film's colour bands, the round spheres inside it, folding back into the same foam and settling to the sink

registers.name: sink
registers.scene: a warm evening kitchen seen from standing height at the sink's edge, looking down across a deep cream-white ceramic basin, a wide window above it full of low amber light, tiled counter and a stack of plates at the near edge, empty, no one present
registers.target: a rounded heap of white soap foam, a packed crust of small round bubbles
registers.loop_target: a warm evening kitchen sink seen from the rim, a deep cream-white ceramic basin heaped with white soap foam, a wide window of low amber light above it

registers.name: foam_field
registers.scene: a packed field of soap bubble domes seen from above, every dome pressed flat against its neighbours into a lattice of curved polygon walls, the field crowded away to a pale ceramic rim beyond, the thin walls glowing teal and white where light passes through, small beads of lather caught in the seams
registers.target: a large bubble dome, its curved wall banded with magenta, gold and green

registers.name: film_wall
registers.scene: the curved wall of a single soap bubble among its neighbours, a thin film banded with wide sweeping stripes of magenta, gold, green and violet colour, the bands folded and marbled across the whole surface, neighbouring domes pressed to it at the seams, a bright silver rim where the wall curves away into shadow
registers.target: a cluster of small clear round spheres, packed in tight bright rows

registers.name: micelle_rows
registers.scene: row upon row of round spheres packed in a glowing lattice, each a smooth ball of soft light with a bright rim, the rows set away in every direction through pale blue-white glow

registers.name: foam_edge
registers.scene: the packed domes of the sink's soap foam seen from above at its edge, curved white walls and teal films crowded to the rim of a deep cream-white ceramic basin, warm window light across the pale ceramic beyond

music_theme: a warm evening kitchen at rest, gentle and iridescent — soft chiming keys over a low hum, opening bright as the foam gives up its glowing inner world, one shimmering bloom of sound on the turn back into the sink
